Savitri Bind vs State Of U.P. And 10 Others on 7 November, 2025

HON'BLE ANIL KUMAR-X, J. 
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted to decide the Criminal Case No. 1101 of 2023 (State vs. Rakesh Bind and others), arising out of Case Crime No. 172 of 2022, under Section 498A,
323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act at Police Station Basdeeh Road, District Ballia which is pending in the Court of Judicial Magistrate-II, Ballia.

entities.text: Criminal Case No. 1101 of 2023 (State vs. Rakesh Bind and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel, therefore, prays that a direction be issued to the learned Magistrate to decide the said case as expeditiously as as possible.

3. Considering the submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant, the court below concerned is directed to decide the aforesaid case as expeditiously and preferably within a period of six months from the date of production of a certified copy of this order, provided there is no legal impediment.
4. The application under Section 529 B.N.S.S. is disposed of accordingly.
